title: S9 Tool Authority Registry
purpose: Machine-readable authority matrix spine for declaring which tool or environment is authoritative for each governed information domain and which tools remain consumers, derivative environments, or temporary workspaces.
governance_rules: Each governed information domain must have one explicitly declared authoritative environment for the stated scope and lifecycle context.
Non-authoritative tools may consume, visualize, or transform information but must not silently become the source of truth.
Changes to authority assignments require governed change control and communication to affected teams.
Automation and integrations must reference the applicable tool-authority entry before writing to governed information.
Project-specific authority mappings must align with organization-level governance and explicitly record approved deviations.

provenance.migration_note: The source scaffold defines matrix governance but intentionally does not enumerate approved tool assignments. Product mappings observed in the parent S9 source are therefore retained only as migration candidates; no production authority assignment has been promoted.
